label: HTML Boilerplate
description: Creates an editable HTML5 document shell with social metadata and a content insertion marker.

defaults.title: HTML Boilerplate
defaults.html_code:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

    <title><?= esc($page_title ?? 'Page Title') ?></title>
    <meta name="description" content="<?= esc($page_description ?? 'Describe this page') ?>">
    <meta name="robots" content="<?= esc($robots ?? 'index, follow') ?>">
    <link rel="canonical" href="<?= esc($canonical_url ?? current_url()) ?>">

    <!-- Open Graph / Facebook / LinkedIn -->
    <meta property="og:type" content="<?= esc($og_type ?? 'website') ?>">
    <meta property="og:site_name" content="<?= esc($site_name ?? 'Website Name') ?>">
    <meta property="og:title" content="<?= esc($social_title ?? $page_title ?? 'Page Title') ?>">
    <meta property="og:description" content="<?= esc($social_description ?? $page_description ?? 'Describe this page') ?>">
    <meta property="og:url" content="<?= esc($canonical_url ?? current_url()) ?>">
    <meta property="og:image" content="<?= esc($social_image ?? '') ?>">
    <meta property="og:image:alt" content="<?= esc($social_image_alt ?? $social_title ?? $page_title ?? 'Page image') ?>">

    <!-- X / Twitter -->
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="<?= esc($twitter_card ?? 'summary_large_image') ?>">
    <meta name="twitter:title" content="<?= esc($social_title ?? $page_title ?? 'Page Title') ?>">
    <meta name="twitter:description" content="<?= esc($social_description ?? $page_description ?? 'Describe this page') ?>">
    <meta name="twitter:image" content="<?= esc($social_image ?? '') ?>">
    <meta name="twitter:image:alt" content="<?= esc($social_image_alt ?? $social_title ?? $page_title ?? 'Page image') ?>">
</head>
<body>
    <main style="margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;max-width:1200px">
        <tvi-content />
    </main>
</body>
</html>

properties.name: html_code
properties.label: HTML boilerplate
properties.help: Edit the full document. <tvi-content /> marks where the owning View source and components connected to Page content are inserted.
